Independent direct dynamics versus phase enumeration agreed for 595 connected labelled graphs and 578628 bounded states; checks test examples but do not substitute for proof.

originality.rationale: The novelty assessed is an energy-indexed arbitrary-graph primitive-three-cycle generating polynomial, the complete two-band energy support with sharp endpoint multiplicities, and cumulative-binomial book-graph energy refinement. Prisner (1994) already provides a general phase-partition existence/classification and is fully credited; Jiang (2010) provides complement and uniformity; Dall'Asta (2006) covers cycles. The earlier book total and arbitrary-graph period-two polynomial are not comparable at the mass-resolved period-three level. Targeted record/source searches found no equal/stronger indexed mass formula. Equivalence risk persists, especially from historical complete phase constructions and inaccessible Bitar–Goles.
residual_risks: Prisner (1994) proves a general constructive classification of activity-one-third phases and thus the formula could be viewed as a further enumeration of known intervals rather than a fundamentally new dynamical mechanism.

value.rationale: The conserved chip mass is a central fixed-energy-sandpile invariant. Unlike a period existence criterion, the result counts each orbit at every mass on every connected graph. It establishes gap-free admissible low- and high-energy bands, universal forbidden middle gap, exact extreme multiplicities, and a nontrivial cumulative-binomial refinement of the previously known book-graph three-cycle total. The structural endpoints connect phase domination and monochromatic-edge optimization. The formula is exponential but provides a reusable rigorous partition function, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
